dispositions.topic_text: Semantics and mechanism of pre-export legacy Room name correction
dispositions.reason: M03's 'a Room is never renamed' binds a room stored in Registry. The correction R0-96 asks is made before the export in the legacy v1 instance on the VPS, outside this document's guarantees (State 0 Actors, Legacy instances; R0-79), with that instance's own means — the same answer State 0 round-61 T4 accepted. No Registry action performs it, and the import stores the names it is given (A16).
